_comment: Curated brand -> product lines. A line is assigned when its text appears in the product name (word-boundary match, spacing/punctuation insensitive); longest match wins. Keys starting with _ are ignored; the key "*" applies to every brand. Grow this from `python evals/enrich/audit.py --db` — it is the cheapest, most durable accuracy fix available, since assignment becomes a string fact instead of a model judgment. Seeded from The Plug (Crown Heights) product names.
_comment_ruby_farms: From the Ruby Farms curation (2026-10-08). Pre-rolls: Doobies are 0.5g joints in 2pk (1g) and 7pk (3.5g); Classics are 7 x 0.7g (5g); Hash Infused are hash-infused 0.5g joints in 2pk (1g) and 10pk (5g), which stores call Hash Infused Doobies or Hash Classics; Rose Petal is the 1.5g hash-infused single rolled in rose petals; Roosevelt is the 3g hash-infused rose-petal cigar; Rosettas a 5 x 0.5g infused pack. The longer spellings exist so the longest match wins: 'Rose Petal Rolled Hash Infused' is Rose Petal, not Hash Infused, and 'Hash Infused Rose Petal Cigar' is Roosevelt.
_comment_stiiizy: From the STIIIZY catalog audit (2026-10-05): stores print these on most listings, enrichment recorded them on under 1 in 10 ("Original" 8 of 73, "Liquid Diamonds" 2 of 68, "LIIIL" 3 of 28). The plain 1g all-in-one has no line name. 32 names say "Liquid Diamond". With a category, the description settles a name that carries no line: 28 of the 29 pre-roll listings without 40's in the name have it in the description (Hold Up Roll Up: 14).
_comment_1906: 1906 sells its tablets as Drops in effects (Bliss, Boost, Chill, Genius, Go, Love, Sleep): the family is the line, the effect is the product. Stores write "1906 - Bliss Drops 2pk".
_comment_herb: Herb (1off Manufacturing, OCM-PROC-000062) prints HASH INFUSED on its infused Ready to Roll 7g bag ('5.6 flower / 1.4 dry sift hash'; ingredients 'cannabis flower, dry sifted hash') and on its infused pre-roll tube ('1 GRAM HASH INFUSED'). Stores write 'Infused Ground Flower', 'Pre Ground Infused Flower', 'Hash Infused Pre roll'. Plain flower, pre-ground and pre-rolls carry no line. 'Ready to Roll' is printed on both plain and infused pre-ground, so it is the format (subtype preground), not a line. Keep this rule without a category: the stock pre-roll blurb stores paste ('can be rolled with flower, shake ... infused with concentrates') would otherwise file plain pre-rolls as Hash Infused.
_comment_heavy_hitters: From the Heavy Hitters curation (2026-10-08); replaces the brand's list. heavyhitters.co/states/new-york: vapes are Ultra (0.5g and 1g Twin Turbo all-in-ones, 2g all-in-one, 1g 510 cart), Slow Cured Resin 1g all-in-one and Live Rosin Solventless 1g all-in-one; gummies (5 x 20mg, 100mg) are Ultra Gummies (Atomic Apple, Holy Grape, Strawberry Storm), Solventless Live Rosin Gummies (Blackberry Lemon, Guava Strawberry, Papaya Mango), Lights Out (CBN sleep: Midnight Cherry; Cloudberry vape) and Lights On (THCV energy: Green Crack); pre-rolls are Diamond Infused (1g 'Diamond Pre-Roll' and 5 x 0.5g 'Diamond Pre-Roll 5ct'), beside the brand's Jelly Roll rosin-infused pre-rolls (CA); 2g Pure Live Rosin jars and 7g Slow Cured Indoor Flower carry no line. Ultra, Live Rosin, Lights On and Lights Out are printed by the brand across formats. Every Heavy Hitters CBN product is Lights Out and every THCV product Lights On, so those words name the line where a store leaves it out ('CBN Cloudberry - 0.5G AIO Vape', 'Green Crack 2:1 THC:THCV Gummies'). Live Rosin stays off the concentrate category: the rosin jars say Live Rosin too and are line-less.
_comment_hashtag_honey: From the hashtaghoneys.com recipe (2026-10-08): Snowballz is the brand's infused-flower family, which stores also spell Snowballs; Lites are its 0.9g x 5 joint packs.
_comment_grassroots: From the Grassroots curation (2026-10-08). Flower: core whole flower 3.5g and 28g jars (no line), Small Buds 7g jar / 14g bag (subtype smalls), Diamond Infused 3.5g (subtype infused). Pre-rolls: 0.4g shorties in 2pk (0.8g) and 5pk (2g), no line; Diamond Infused 1g singles and 5pk (2g) shorties. Dark Heart Collection is the Grassroots x Dark Heart strain collection (Titan Express, Delphi Diesel, Foreign Kush Mints, Moonbeam Gelato, Triple Stack, Zesty Garlic Cookies, Blackened Blue); stores also write Dark Heart, Dark Heart Genetics, Grassroots x Dark Heart. An infused Dark Heart product is Diamond Infused: the longer 'Dark Heart ... Infused' spellings are here so the longest match picks Diamond Infused.
_comment_jeeter: From the Jeeter curation (2026-10-08). jeeter.com/locations/new-york sells NY pre-rolls as Baby Jeeter (5 x 0.5g, 2.5g total), the 1g Jeeter single (no family name: no line) and Jeeter XL (2g, glass tip). Stores print 'Baby Jeeter' and 'XL' on nearly every 2.5g and 2g listing; enrichment recorded them on 7 of 14 and 1 of 6 catalog products. 'XL' alone covers 'Quad-Infused XL Jeeter Joint' and 'Pina Colada XL'; the category keeps it off the 2g Diamonds XL all-in-ones. Seasonal and limited collections (Summer Essentials, Autumn Essentials, World Cup) run across formats and are not lines.
_comment_lost_farm: Lost Farm (Kiva) gummies: the brand prints the extract on every pack as the family ('Made with Live Resin', 'Solventless Live Rosin'), and the kivaconfections.com recipe reads it as the line. Stores write it in the name; without these rules enrichment took the brand ('Lost Farms'), the strain ('Napa', 'Moroccan Peaches') or the fruit+strain pair ('Trop Cherries') as the line. Bare 'Resin'/'Rosin' are left out on purpose: two stores write 'Rosin' on the Live Resin Raspberry x Wedding Cake.
_comment_dank: From the Dank By Definition curation (2026-10-08). Infused pre-rolls (the brand's INFUSED PRE-ROLLS; packages print 'INFUSED JOINT(S)' / 'Infused Blunt') are line Infused: 1g and 1.1g joints, 1.35g blunts, 5 x 0.55g packs (2.75g). Name-only on purpose (no category): store descriptions of Dank's PLAIN pre-rolls often carry the boilerplate 'Pre-Rolls come in many different forms and can be rolled with flower, shake, "b-buds", infused with concentrates, and more', which a description rule would read as infused.
_comment_cannabals: From the Cannabals curation (2026-10-08), checked against Cirona's NYS Wholesale Catalog (Winter-Spring 2025) and the CANNABALS Fall 2026 sheet. Puffs are the diamond infused 7 x 0.5g pre-rolls (catalog p9, 'PUFFS by Cannabals'); one store writes 'Puff'. Chubby Puff is the 6g all-in-one (package 'CHUBBY PUFF 1200'); one store writes 'Chubby Puffy'. Brick is the 100mg scored gummy bar (catalog p4, 'BRICK by Cannabals'). Mood State is the brand's family across vapes and gummies (catalog p6, p7), so it takes no category. A category keeps 'Puff' and 'Brick' from firing on vape descriptions ('1200+ puffs').
_comment_edie_parker: From the Edie Parker curation (2026-10-08). Vapes (1g carts and Petal Puffer all-in-ones) come in the brand's effect families Good Morning (sativa), Good Afternoon (hybrid) and Good Night (indica): the Petal Puffer tin prints 'For a Good Afternoon' and NY stores write 'Lavender Vanilla (Good Night) Cartridge - 1g'. Pre-rolls are Blossoms (7 x 0.5g, 3.5g; stores also write 'Blossom') and Best Buds (twin pack of 0.5g, 1g); flower is the Flower Pot 1/8oz jar, a name stores leave out of the title but paste into descriptions ('1/8 oz Flower Pot Premium indoor whole flower'). Early Bird, Happiest Hour and Nightcap are the blends inside those lines (the product), not lines.
_comment_anthem: From the Anthem curation (2026-10-08). Anthem (Curaleaf) sells only pre-rolls: the core 0.35g cigarette-style blends (Indica / Sativa / Hybrid Blend, 5 and 10 packs, no line) and the Bold infused pre-rolls (1g glass- or wood-tip single, 5 x 0.5g = 2.5g pack). Every Anthem infused, glass-tip or wood-tip pre-roll is Bold (anthemcannabisusa.com; Weedmaps brand catalog), so those words assign Bold. The first entry has a category so descriptions that say 'Anthem Bold' file a line-less name; 'Infused' sits in a second entry without a category so it works on names only: generic Dutchie blurbs on Blend 10-packs say 'infused with concentrates'.
